title: Hearty Spanish Parma Ham Paella
description: A winey and adventurous Spanish dish featuring Parma ham, this keto-friendly paella is a twist on the traditional Valencian recipe, with a glassy-jelly texture from the reduction of white wine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Parma ham and cook until crispy, then remove from the pan and set aside.
Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned on all sides, then remove from the pan and set aside with the ham.
Add the sliced Spanish sausage to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the white wine to the pan and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the wine for 10 minutes, or until it has reduced by half and has a glassy-jelly texture.
Add the chicken broth, saffron threads, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Add the cooked chicken breast and Parma ham back to the pan, stirring to combine with the sauce.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the paella is hot and flavorful.
